passages.text: Now King David was old and well along in years, and though they covered him with blankets, he could not keep warm.
passages.sermon:
King David was old.
He had lived many years.
They covered him with blankets.
He could not keep warm.
passages.original: וְהַמֶּ֤לֶךְ דָּוִד֙ זָקֵ֔ן בָּ֖א בַּיָּמִ֑ים וַיְכַסֻּ֙הוּ֙ בַּבְּגָדִ֔ים וְלֹ֥א יִחַ֖ם לֽוֹ׃

passages.text: So his servants said to him, “Let us search for a young virgin for our lord the king, to attend to him and care for him and lie by his side to keep him warm.”
passages.sermon:
King David was old.
He was well along in years.
He could not keep warm, even when covered with blankets.
His servants spoke to him.
They said, “Let us search for a young virgin for our lord the king.
She will stand before the king.
She will attend to him.
She will care for him.
She will lie by your side.
She will keep our lord the king warm.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֧אמְרוּ ל֣וֹ עֲבָדָ֗יו יְבַקְשׁ֞וּ לַאדֹנִ֤י הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ נַעֲרָ֣ה בְתוּלָ֔ה וְעָֽמְדָה֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וּתְהִי־ ל֖וֹ סֹכֶ֑נֶת וְשָׁכְבָ֣ה בְחֵיקֶ֔ךָ וְחַ֖ם לַאדֹנִ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

passages.text: Then they searched throughout Israel for a beautiful girl, and they found Abishag the Shunammite and brought her to the king.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
David was old.
David could not keep warm.
His servants searched for a beautiful girl.
They searched everywhere in Israel.
They found Abishag.
Abishag was from Shunem.
They brought Abishag to the king.
passages.original: וַיְבַקְשׁוּ֙ נַעֲרָ֣ה יָפָ֔ה בְּכֹ֖ל גְּב֣וּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽיִּמְצְא֗וּ אֶת־ אֲבִישַׁג֙ הַשּׁ֣וּנַמִּ֔ית וַיָּבִ֥אוּ אֹתָ֖הּ לַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

passages.text: The girl was unsurpassed in beauty; she cared for the king and served him, but he had no relations with her.
passages.sermon:
Abishag was a young woman.
She was from Shunem.
She was very beautiful.
No other girl was as beautiful as her.
Abishag cared for King David.
She served King David.
King David did not have relations with her.
passages.original: וְהַֽנַּעֲרָ֖ה יָפָ֣ה עַד־ מְאֹ֑ד וַתְּהִ֨י לַמֶּ֤לֶךְ סֹכֶ֙נֶת֙ וַתְּשָׁ֣רְתֵ֔הוּ וְהַמֶּ֖לֶךְ לֹ֥א יְדָעָֽהּ׃

passages.text: At that time Adonijah, David’s son by Haggith, began to exalt himself, saying, “I will be king!” And he acquired chariots and horsemen and fifty men to run ahead of him.
passages.sermon:
Adonijah was the son of David and Haggith.
Adonijah began to make himself important.
He said, “I will be king.”
Adonijah got chariots for himself.
He got horsemen for himself.
He chose fifty men to run in front of him.
passages.original: וַאֲדֹנִיָּ֧ה בֶן־ חַגִּ֛ית מִתְנַשֵּׂ֥א לֵאמֹ֖ר אֲנִ֣י אֶמְלֹ֑ךְ וַיַּ֣עַשׂ ל֗וֹ רֶ֚כֶב וּפָ֣רָשִׁ֔ים וַחֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אִ֖ישׁ רָצִ֥ים לְפָנָֽיו׃

passages.text: (His father had never once reprimanded him by saying, “Why do you act this way?” Adonijah was also very handsome, born next after Absalom.)
passages.sermon:
Adonijah was the son of King David and Haggith.
Adonijah was born after Absalom.
Adonijah was very handsome.
King David never reprimanded Adonijah at any time.
King David never asked Adonijah, “Why do you act this way?”
passages.original: וְלֹֽא־ עֲצָב֨וֹ אָבִ֤יו מִיָּמָיו֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר מַדּ֖וּעַ כָּ֣כָה עָשִׂ֑יתָ וְגַם־ ה֤וּא טֽוֹב־ תֹּ֙אַר֙ מְאֹ֔ד וְאֹת֥וֹ יָלְדָ֖ה אַחֲרֵ֥י אַבְשָׁלֽוֹם׃

passages.text: So Adonijah conferred with Joab son of Zeruiah and with Abiathar the priest, who supported him.
passages.sermon:
Adonijah was the son of David and Haggith.
Adonijah wanted to make himself king.
Adonijah spoke with Joab.
Joab was the son of Zeruiah.
Adonijah also spoke with Abiathar.
Abiathar was a priest.
Joab and Abiathar supported Adonijah.
passages.original: וַיִּהְי֣וּ דְבָרָ֔יו עִ֚ם יוֹאָ֣ב בֶּן־ צְרוּיָ֔ה וְעִ֖ם אֶבְיָתָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֑ן וַֽיַּעְזְר֔וּ אַחֲרֵ֖י אֲדֹנִיָּֽה׃

passages.text: But Zadok the priest, Benaiah son of Jehoiada, Nathan the prophet, Shimei, Rei, and David’s mighty men would not join Adonijah.
passages.sermon:
Zadok was a priest.
Benaiah was the son of Jehoiada.
Nathan was a prophet.
Shimei and Rei were important men.
David had mighty warriors.
These men did not support Adonijah.
They did not join him.
passages.original: וְצָד֣וֹק הַ֠כֹּהֵן וּבְנָיָ֨הוּ בֶן־ יְהוֹיָדָ֜ע וְנָתָ֤ן הַנָּבִיא֙ וְשִׁמְעִ֣י וְרֵעִ֔י וְהַגִּבּוֹרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְדָוִ֑ד לֹ֥א הָי֖וּ עִם־ אֲדֹנִיָּֽהוּ׃

passages.text: And Adonijah sacrificed sheep, oxen, and fattened calves near the stone of Zoheleth, which is next to En-rogel. He invited all his royal brothers and all the men of Judah who were servants of the king.
passages.sermon:
Adonijah was the son of Haggith.
Adonijah sacrificed sheep.
Adonijah sacrificed oxen.
Adonijah sacrificed fattened calves.
He did this near the stone of Zoheleth.
The stone of Zoheleth is next to En-rogel.
Adonijah invited all his brothers.
His brothers were sons of the king.
Adonijah also invited all the men of Judah.
These men were servants of the king.
passages.original: וַיִּזְבַּ֣ח אֲדֹנִיָּ֗הוּ צֹ֤אן וּבָקָר֙ וּמְרִ֔יא עִ֚ם אֶ֣בֶן הַזֹּחֶ֔לֶת אֲשֶׁר־ אֵ֖צֶל עֵ֣ין רֹגֵ֑ל וַיִּקְרָ֗א אֶת־ כָּל־ אֶחָיו֙ בְּנֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וּלְכָל־ אַנְשֵׁ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה עַבְדֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

passages.text: But he did not invite Nathan the prophet, Benaiah, the mighty men, or his brother Solomon.
passages.sermon:
Adonijah did not invite Nathan.
Nathan was a prophet.
Adonijah did not invite Benaiah.
Benaiah was the son of Jehoiada.
Adonijah did not invite the mighty men.
The mighty men served David.
Adonijah did not invite Solomon.
Solomon was Adonijah’s brother.
passages.original: וְֽאֶת־ נָתָן֩ הַנָּבִ֨יא וּבְנָיָ֜הוּ וְאֶת־ הַגִּבּוֹרִ֛ים וְאֶת־ שְׁלֹמֹ֥ה אָחִ֖יו לֹ֥א קָרָֽא׃

passages.text: Then Nathan said to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon, “Have you not heard that Adonijah son of Haggith has become king, and our lord David does not know it?
passages.sermon:
Nathan was a prophet of God.
Bathsheba was the mother of Solomon.
Nathan spoke to Bathsheba.
Nathan said, “Adonijah is the son of Haggith.
Adonijah has made himself king.
King David is our lord.
David does not know that Adonijah has become king.
Have you not heard this?”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר נָתָ֗ן אֶל־ בַּת־ שֶׁ֤בַע אֵם־ שְׁלֹמֹה֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הֲל֣וֹא שָׁמַ֔עַתְּ כִּ֥י מָלַ֖ךְ אֲדֹנִיָּ֣הוּ בֶן־ חַגִּ֑ית וַאֲדֹנֵ֥ינוּ דָוִ֖ד לֹ֥א יָדָֽע׃

passages.text: Now please, come and let me advise you. Save your own life and the life of your son Solomon.
passages.sermon:
Nathan was a prophet.
Nathan spoke to Bathsheba.
Bathsheba was the mother of Solomon.
Nathan said, “Come here.
I will give you advice.
You must save your life.
You must also save the life of your son Solomon.”
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה לְכִ֛י אִיעָצֵ֥ךְ נָ֖א עֵצָ֑ה וּמַלְּטִי֙ אֶת־ נַפְשֵׁ֔ךְ וְאֶת־ נֶ֥פֶשׁ בְּנֵ֖ךְ שְׁלֹמֹֽה׃

passages.text: Go at once to King David and say, ‘My lord the king, did you not swear to your maidservant, “Surely your son Solomon will reign after me, and he will sit on my throne”? Why then has Adonijah become king?’
passages.sermon:
Bathsheba was the mother of Solomon.
Nathan spoke to Bathsheba.
Nathan told her what to do.
Nathan said, "Go at once to King David."
King David was the king of Israel.
Nathan told Bathsheba to speak to King David.
Nathan said, "Say to him, 'My lord the king, did you not swear to your maidservant?'
Say, 'You promised that Solomon your son will reign after you.'
Say, 'You said Solomon will sit on your throne.'
Say, 'Why then has Adonijah become king?'"
passages.original: לְכִ֞י וּבֹ֣אִי׀ אֶל־ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֗ד וְאָמַ֤רְתְּ אֵלָיו֙ הֲלֹֽא־ אַתָּ֞ה אֲדֹנִ֣י הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ נִשְׁבַּ֤עְתָּ לַאֲמָֽתְךָ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר כִּֽי־ שְׁלֹמֹ֤ה בְנֵךְ֙ יִמְלֹ֣ךְ אַחֲרַ֔י וְה֖וּא יֵשֵׁ֣ב עַל־ כִּסְאִ֑י וּמַדּ֖וּעַ מָלַ֥ךְ אֲדֹנִיָֽהוּ׃

passages.text: Then, while you are still there speaking with the king, I will come in after you and confirm your words.”
passages.sermon:
Nathan was a prophet of God.
Nathan spoke to Bathsheba, the wife of King David.
Nathan gave Bathsheba instructions to save her life and her son Solomon’s life.
Nathan said, “You will go to King David and speak with him.”
Nathan said, “While you are still speaking with the king, I will come in after you.”
Nathan said, “I will confirm your words to the king.”
passages.original: הִנֵּ֗ה עוֹדָ֛ךְ מְדַבֶּ֥רֶת שָׁ֖ם עִם־ הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַאֲנִי֙ אָב֣וֹא אַחֲרַ֔יִךְ וּמִלֵּאתִ֖י אֶת־ דְּבָרָֽיִךְ׃

passages.text: So Bathsheba went to see the king in his bedroom. Since the king was very old, Abishag the Shunammite was serving him.
passages.sermon:
Bathsheba was Solomon’s mother.
She went to see King David.
She entered the king’s bedroom.
King David was very old.
Abishag was a woman from Shunem.
Abishag was serving King David.
passages.original: וַתָּבֹ֨א בַת־ שֶׁ֤בֶע אֶל־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ הַחַ֔דְרָה וְהַמֶּ֖לֶךְ זָקֵ֣ן מְאֹ֑ד וַֽאֲבִישַׁג֙ הַשּׁ֣וּנַמִּ֔ית מְשָׁרַ֖ת אֶת־ הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

passages.text: And Bathsheba bowed down in homage to the king, who asked, “What is your desire?”
passages.sermon:
Bathsheba was the wife of David.
David was the king of Israel.
Bathsheba entered the king’s room.
Bathsheba bowed down before King David.
Bathsheba showed respect to the king.
King David saw Bathsheba.
King David spoke to her.
King David asked, “What do you want?”
passages.original: וַתִּקֹּ֣ד בַּת־ שֶׁ֔בַע וַתִּשְׁתַּ֖חוּ לַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיֹּ֥אמֶר הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ מַה־ לָּֽךְ׃

passages.text: “My lord,” she replied, “you yourself swore to your maidservant by the LORD your God: ‘Surely your son Solomon will reign after me, and he will sit on my throne.’
passages.sermon:
Bathsheba spoke to King David.
King David was very old.
Bathsheba said, “My lord, you made a promise to me.
You swore by the LORD your God.
You said, ‘Your son Solomon will be king after me.
He will sit on my throne.’”
passages.original: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ אֲדֹנִי֙ אַתָּ֨ה נִשְׁבַּ֜עְתָּ בַּֽיהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ לַֽאֲמָתֶ֔ךָ כִּֽי־ שְׁלֹמֹ֥ה בְנֵ֖ךְ יִמְלֹ֣ךְ אַחֲרָ֑י וְה֖וּא יֵשֵׁ֥ב עַל־ כִּסְאִֽי׃

passages.text: But now, behold, Adonijah has become king, and you, my lord the king, did not know it.
passages.sermon:
Adonijah is the son of King David.
Adonijah has become king.
You are King David.
You did not know that Adonijah became king.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה הִנֵּ֥ה אֲדֹנִיָּ֖ה מָלָ֑ךְ וְעַתָּ֛ה אֲדֹנִ֥י הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ לֹ֥א יָדָֽעְתָּ׃

passages.text: And he has sacrificed an abundance of oxen, fattened calves, and sheep, and has invited all the other sons of the king, as well as Abiathar the priest and Joab the commander of the army. But he did not invite your servant Solomon.
passages.sermon:
Adonijah is the subject.
Adonijah sacrificed many oxen.
Adonijah sacrificed many fattened calves.
Adonijah sacrificed many sheep.
Adonijah invited all the other sons of the king.
Adonijah invited Abiathar the priest.
Adonijah invited Joab, the commander of the army.
Adonijah did not invite Solomon, your servant.
passages.original: וַ֠יִּזְבַּח שׁ֥וֹר וּֽמְרִיא־ וְצֹאן֮ לָרֹב֒ וַיִּקְרָא֙ לְכָל־ בְּנֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וּלְאֶבְיָתָר֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וּלְיֹאָ֖ב שַׂ֣ר הַצָּבָ֑א וְלִשְׁלֹמֹ֥ה עַבְדְּךָ֖ לֹ֥א קָרָֽא׃

passages.text: And as for you, my lord the king, the eyes of all Israel are upon you to tell them who will sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.
passages.sermon:
King David is the ruler of Israel.
All Israel looks to King David.
The people wait for King David to speak.
They want King David to tell them something important.
They want to know who will sit on King David’s throne after him.
passages.original: וְאַתָּה֙ אֲדֹנִ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ עֵינֵ֥י כָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עָלֶ֑יךָ לְהַגִּ֣יד לָהֶ֔ם מִ֗י יֵשֵׁ֛ב עַל־ כִּסֵּ֥א אֲדֹנִֽי־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ אַחֲרָֽיו׃

passages.text: Otherwise, when my lord the king rests with his fathers, I and my son Solomon will be counted as criminals.”
passages.sermon:
Bathsheba spoke to King David.
She said, “My lord the king, you will one day rest with your fathers.
When that happens, people will see me and my son Solomon as criminals.
They will count us as guilty.”
passages.original: וְהָיָ֕ה כִּשְׁכַ֥ב אֲדֹנִֽי־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֑יו וְהָיִ֗יתִי אֲנִ֛י וּבְנִ֥י שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה חַטָּאִֽים׃

passages.text: And just then, while Bathsheba was still speaking with the king, Nathan the prophet arrived.
passages.sermon: Bathsheba was speaking with King David.\r\nNathan was a prophet.\r\nNathan arrived while Bathsheba was still speaking with the king.
passages.original: וְהִנֵּ֛ה עוֹדֶ֥נָּה מְדַבֶּ֖רֶת עִם־ הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וְנָתָ֥ן הַנָּבִ֖יא בָּֽא׃

passages.text: So the king was told, “Nathan the prophet is here.” And Nathan went in and bowed facedown before the king.
passages.sermon:
Nathan was a prophet in Israel.
Someone told the king, “Nathan the prophet is here.”
Nathan entered the room where the king was.
Nathan bowed down before the king.
Nathan put his face to the ground.
passages.original: וַיַּגִּ֤ידוּ לַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הִנֵּ֖ה נָתָ֣ן הַנָּבִ֑יא וַיָּבֹא֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַיִּשְׁתַּ֧חוּ לַמֶּ֛לֶךְ עַל־ אַפָּ֖יו אָֽרְצָה׃

passages.text: “My lord the king,” said Nathan, “did you say, ‘Adonijah will reign after me, and he will sit on my throne’?
passages.sermon:
Nathan was a prophet of God.
Nathan spoke to King David.
Nathan said, “My lord the king, did you say this?”
Nathan asked, “Did you say, ‘Adonijah will rule after me?’”
Nathan asked, “Did you say, ‘Adonijah will sit on my throne?’”
passages.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֮ נָתָן֒ אֲדֹנִ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ אַתָּ֣ה אָמַ֔רְתָּ אֲדֹנִיָּ֖הוּ יִמְלֹ֣ךְ אַחֲרָ֑י וְה֖וּא יֵשֵׁ֥ב עַל־ כִּסְאִֽי׃

passages.text: For today he has gone down and sacrificed an abundance of oxen, fattened calves, and sheep, and has invited all the sons of the king, the commanders of the army, and Abiathar the priest. And behold, they are eating and drinking before him, saying, ‘Long live King Adonijah!’
passages.sermon:
Adonijah is the son of King David.
Today Adonijah went down.
He sacrificed many oxen.
He sacrificed many fattened calves.
He sacrificed many sheep.
Adonijah invited all the sons of the king.
He invited the commanders of the army.
He invited Abiathar the priest.
They are eating before Adonijah.
They are drinking before Adonijah.
They are saying, “Long live King Adonijah!”
passages.original: כִּ֣י׀ יָרַ֣ד הַיּ֗וֹם וַ֠יִּזְבַּח שׁ֥וֹר וּֽמְרִיא־ וְצֹאן֮ לָרֹב֒ וַיִּקְרָא֩ לְכָל־ בְּנֵ֨י הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ וּלְשָׂרֵ֤י הַצָּבָא֙ וּלְאֶבְיָתָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְהִנָּ֛ם אֹכְלִ֥ים וְשֹׁתִ֖ים לְפָנָ֑יו וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ יְחִ֖י הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ אֲדֹנִיָּֽהוּ׃

passages.text: But me your servant he did not invite, nor Zadok the priest, nor Benaiah son of Jehoiada, nor your servant Solomon.
passages.sermon:
Adonijah did not invite me.
I am your servant.
He did not invite Zadok the priest.
He did not invite Benaiah son of Jehoiada.
He did not invite your servant Solomon.
passages.original: וְלִ֣י אֲנִֽי־ עַ֠בְדֶּךָ וּלְצָדֹ֨ק הַכֹּהֵ֜ן וְלִבְנָיָ֧הוּ בֶן־ יְהוֹיָדָ֛ע וְלִשְׁלֹמֹ֥ה עַבְדְּךָ֖ לֹ֥א קָרָֽא׃

passages.text: Has my lord the king let this happen without informing your servant who should sit on the throne after my lord the king?”
passages.sermon:
King David was the ruler of Israel.
Someone has acted as if he will be king after David.
I am your servant.
You did not tell me about this matter.
Did my lord the king allow this to happen?
Did you not inform your servant who will sit on your throne after you?
passages.original: אִ֗ם מֵאֵת֙ אֲדֹנִ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ נִהְיָ֖ה הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֑ה וְלֹ֤א הוֹדַ֙עְתָּ֙ אֶֽת־ עַבְדֶּיךָ מִ֗י יֵשֵׁ֛ב עַל־ כִּסֵּ֥א אֲדֹנִֽי־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ אַחֲרָֽיו׃ס

passages.text: Then King David said, “Call in Bathsheba for me.” So she came into the king’s presence and stood before him.
passages.sermon:
King David was the ruler of Israel.
King David spoke.
He said, “Call Bathsheba for me.”
Bathsheba was Solomon’s mother.
Bathsheba came into the king’s presence.
She stood before King David.
passages.original: וַיַּ֨עַן הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ דָּוִד֙ וַיֹּ֔אמֶר קִרְאוּ־ לִ֖י לְבַת־ שָׁ֑בַע וַתָּבֹא֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַֽתַּעֲמֹ֖ד לִפְנֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

passages.text: And the king swore an oath, saying, “As surely as the LORD lives, who has redeemed my life from all distress, I will carry out this very day exactly what I swore to you by the LORD, the God of Israel: Surely your son Solomon will reign after me, and he will sit on my throne in my place.”
passages.sermon:
King David spoke.
King David made an oath.
He said, “As surely as the LORD lives, who has saved me from all trouble, I will keep my promise to you today.
I swore to you by the LORD, the God of Israel.
I said your son Solomon will be king after me.
Solomon will sit on my throne in my place.
I will do this today.”
passages.original: וַיִּשָּׁבַ֥ע הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ וַיֹּאמַ֑ר חַי־ יְהוָ֕ה אֲשֶׁר־ פָּדָ֥ה אֶת־ נַפְשִׁ֖י מִכָּל־ צָרָֽה׃ כִּ֡י כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ נִשְׁבַּ֨עְתִּי לָ֜ךְ בַּיהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר כִּֽי־ שְׁלֹמֹ֤ה בְנֵךְ֙ יִמְלֹ֣ךְ אַחֲרַ֔י וְה֛וּא יֵשֵׁ֥ב עַל־ כִּסְאִ֖י תַּחְתָּ֑י כִּ֛י כֵּ֥ן אֶעֱשֶׂ֖ה הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: Bathsheba bowed facedown in homage to the king and said, “May my lord King David live forever!”
passages.sermon:
Bathsheba stood before King David.
Bathsheba bowed down with her face to the ground.
Bathsheba showed honor to King David.
Bathsheba said, “May my lord King David live forever.”
passages.original: וַתִּקֹּ֨ד בַּת־ שֶׁ֤בַע אַפַּ֙יִם֙ אֶ֔רֶץ וַתִּשְׁתַּ֖חוּ לַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַתֹּ֕אמֶר יְחִ֗י אֲדֹנִ֛י הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ דָּוִ֖ד לְעֹלָֽם׃פ

passages.text: Then King David said, “Call in for me Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah son of Jehoiada.” So they came before the king.
passages.sermon:
King David was the ruler of Israel and Judah.
King David spoke.
He gave a command.
He said, “Call Zadok the priest for me.
Call Nathan the prophet for me.
Call Benaiah son of Jehoiada for me.”
Zadok, Nathan, and Benaiah came.
They stood before King David.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר׀ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֗ד קִרְאוּ־ לִ֞י לְצָד֤וֹק הַכֹּהֵן֙ וּלְנָתָ֣ן הַנָּבִ֔יא וְלִבְנָיָ֖הוּ בֶּן־ יְהוֹיָדָ֑ע וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ לִפְנֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

passages.text: “Take my servants with you,” said the king. “Set my son Solomon on my own mule and take him down to Gihon.
passages.sermon:
King David spoke to them.
He said, “Take my servants with you.
Put my son Solomon on my mule.
This mule belongs to me.
Lead Solomon down to Gihon.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ לָהֶ֗ם קְח֤וּ עִמָּכֶם֙ אֶת־ עַבְדֵ֣י אֲדֹנֵיכֶ֔ם וְהִרְכַּבְתֶּם֙ אֶת־ שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנִ֔י עַל־ הַפִּרְדָּ֖ה אֲשֶׁר־ לִ֑י וְהוֹרַדְתֶּ֥ם אֹת֖וֹ אֶל־ גִּחֽוֹן׃

passages.text: There Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet are to anoint him king over Israel. You are to blow the ram’s horn and declare, ‘Long live King Solomon!’
passages.sermon:
Zadok is a priest.
Nathan is a prophet.
They will go to Gihon.
They will anoint Solomon as king over Israel.
You must blow the ram’s horn.
You must say, “Long live King Solomon!”
passages.original: וּמָשַׁ֣ח אֹת֣וֹ שָׁ֠ם צָד֨וֹק הַכֹּהֵ֜ן וְנָתָ֧ן הַנָּבִ֛יא לְמֶ֖לֶךְ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּתְקַעְתֶּם֙ בַּשּׁוֹפָ֔ר וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֕ם יְחִ֖י הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹֽה׃

passages.text: Then you shall go up with him, and he is to come and sit on my throne and reign in my place. For I have appointed him ruler over Israel and Judah.”
passages.sermon:
King David spoke to his servants.
King David gave them instructions about Solomon.
He said, "You must go up with Solomon."
Solomon will come with you.
He will sit on my throne.
Solomon will rule in my place.
I have appointed Solomon as ruler.
He will rule over Israel.
He will rule over Judah."
passages.original: וַעֲלִיתֶ֣ם אַחֲרָ֗יו וּבָא֙ וְיָשַׁ֣ב עַל־ כִּסְאִ֔י וְה֥וּא יִמְלֹ֖ךְ תַּחְתָּ֑י וְאֹת֤וֹ צִוִּ֙יתִי֙ לִֽהְי֣וֹת נָגִ֔יד עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְעַל־ יְהוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: “Amen,” replied Benaiah son of Jehoiada. “May the LORD, the God of my lord the king, so declare it.
passages.sermon:
Benaiah was the son of Jehoiada.
Benaiah spoke to the king.
Benaiah said, “Amen.”
Benaiah said, “May the LORD declare it.”
The LORD is the God of my lord the king.
passages.original: וַיַּ֨עַן בְּנָיָ֧הוּ בֶן־ יְהֽוֹיָדָ֛ע אֶת־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר׀ אָמֵ֑ן כֵּ֚ן יֹאמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֱלֹהֵ֖י אֲדֹנִ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

passages.text: Just as the LORD was with my lord the king, so may He be with Solomon and make his throne even greater than that of my lord King David.”
passages.sermon: The LORD was with my lord the king David.\r\nMay the LORD also be with Solomon.\r\nMay the LORD make Solomon’s throne greater than the throne of my lord King David.
passages.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר הָיָ֤ה יְהוָה֙ עִם־ אֲדֹנִ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ כֵּ֖ן יְהִי עִם־ שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה וִֽיגַדֵּל֙ אֶת־ כִּסְא֔וֹ מִ֨כִּסֵּ֔א אֲדֹנִ֖י הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ דָּוִֽד׃

passages.text: Then Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah son of Jehoiada, along with the Cherethites and Pelethites, went down and set Solomon on King David’s mule, and they escorted him to Gihon.
passages.sermon:
Zadok was a priest.
Nathan was a prophet.
Benaiah was the son of Jehoiada.
The Cherethites and the Pelethites were royal guards.
These men went down together.
They placed Solomon on King David’s mule.
They led Solomon to Gihon.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֣רֶד צָד֣וֹק הַ֠כֹּהֵן וְנָתָ֨ן הַנָּבִ֜יא וּבְנָיָ֣הוּ בֶן־ יְהוֹיָדָ֗ע וְהַכְּרֵתִי֙ וְהַפְּלֵתִ֔י וַיַּרְכִּ֙בוּ֙ אֶת־ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה עַל־ פִּרְדַּ֖ת הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֑ד וַיֹּלִ֥כוּ אֹת֖וֹ עַל־ גִּחֽוֹן׃

passages.text: Zadok the priest took the horn of oil from the tabernacle and anointed Solomon. Then they blew the ram’s horn, and all the people proclaimed, “Long live King Solomon!”
passages.sermon:
Zadok was a priest.
Zadok took a horn of oil.
The horn of oil was from the tabernacle.
Zadok anointed Solomon with the oil.
They blew the ram’s horn.
All the people spoke together.
They said, “Long live King Solomon!”
passages.original: וַיִּקַּח֩ צָד֨וֹק הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת־ קֶ֤רֶן הַשֶּׁ֙מֶן֙ מִן־ הָאֹ֔הֶל וַיִּמְשַׁ֖ח אֶת־ שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה וַֽיִּתְקְעוּ֙ בַּשּׁוֹפָ֔ר וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ כָּל־ הָעָ֔ם יְחִ֖י הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹֽה׃

passages.text: All the people followed him, playing flutes and rejoicing with such a great joy that the earth was split by the sound.
passages.sermon:
All the people followed Solomon.
The people played flutes.
The people rejoiced.
Their joy was very great.
The sound of their celebration was so loud that the earth split.
passages.original: וַיַּעֲל֤וּ כָל־ הָעָם֙ אַֽחֲרָ֔יו וְהָעָם֙ מְחַלְּלִ֣ים בַּחֲלִלִ֔ים וּשְׂמֵחִ֖ים שִׂמְחָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֑ה וַתִּבָּקַ֥ע הָאָ֖רֶץ בְּקוֹלָֽם׃

passages.text: Now Adonijah and all his guests were finishing their feast when they heard the sound of the ram’s horn. “Why is the city in such a loud uproar?” asked Joab.
passages.sermon:
Adonijah was the son of King David.
Adonijah was with his guests.
They were finishing their feast.
They heard the sound of the ram’s horn.
Joab was with them.
Joab heard the sound of the ram’s horn.
Joab asked a question.
Joab said, “Why is the city in such a loud uproar?”
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע אֲדֹנִיָּ֗הוּ וְכָל־ הַקְּרֻאִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֔וֹ וְהֵ֖ם כִּלּ֣וּ לֶאֱכֹ֑ל וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע יוֹאָב֙ אֶת־ ק֣וֹל הַשּׁוֹפָ֔ר וַיֹּ֕אמֶר מַדּ֥וּעַ קֽוֹל־ הַקִּרְיָ֖ה הוֹמָֽה׃

passages.text: As he was speaking, suddenly Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest arrived. “Come in,” said Adonijah, “for you are a man of valor. You must be bringing good news.”
passages.sermon:
Jonathan was the son of Abiathar the priest.
Jonathan arrived while the others were still speaking.
Adonijah saw Jonathan come in.
Adonijah said, “Come in.”
Adonijah called Jonathan a man of valor.
Adonijah said, “You must be bringing good news.”
passages.original: עוֹדֶ֣נּוּ מְדַבֵּ֔ר וְהִנֵּ֧ה יוֹנָתָ֛ן בֶּן־ אֶבְיָתָ֥ר הַכֹּהֵ֖ן בָּ֑א וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲדֹנִיָּ֙הוּ֙ בֹּ֔א כִּ֣י אִ֥ישׁ חַ֛יִל אַ֖תָּה וְט֥וֹב תְּבַשֵּֽׂר׃

passages.text: “Not at all,” Jonathan replied. “Our lord King David has made Solomon king.
passages.sermon:
Jonathan was the son of Abiathar the priest.
Jonathan spoke to Adonijah.
Jonathan said, “No, it is not good news.”
King David is our lord.
King David has made Solomon king.
passages.original: וַיַּ֙עַן֙ יוֹנָתָ֔ן וַיֹּ֖אמֶר לַאֲדֹנִיָּ֑הוּ אֲבָ֕ל אֲדֹנֵ֥ינוּ הַמֶּֽלֶךְ־ דָּוִ֖ד הִמְלִ֥יךְ אֶת־ שְׁלֹמֹֽה׃

passages.text: And with Solomon, the king has sent Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah son of Jehoiada, along with the Cherethites and Pelethites, and they have set him on the king’s mule.
passages.sermon:
King David acted.
He sent several important men with Solomon.
He sent Zadok the priest.
He sent Nathan the prophet.
He sent Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada.
He also sent the Cherethites.
He also sent the Pelethites.
They put Solomon on the king’s mule.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח אִתּֽוֹ־ הַ֠מֶּלֶךְ אֶת־ צָד֨וֹק הַכֹּהֵ֜ן וְאֶת־ נָתָ֣ן הַנָּבִ֗יא וּבְנָיָ֙הוּ֙ בֶּן־ יְה֣וֹיָדָ֔ע וְהַכְּרֵתִ֖י וְהַפְּלֵתִ֑י וַיַּרְכִּ֣בוּ אֹת֔וֹ עַ֖ל פִּרְדַּ֥ת הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

passages.text: Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king at Gihon, and they have gone up from there with rejoicing that rings out in the city. That is the noise you hear.
passages.sermon:
Zadok is a priest.
Nathan is a prophet.
Zadok and Nathan anointed Solomon as king.
They did this at Gihon.
Afterward, they left Gihon.
They were rejoicing as they went.
Their joy filled the city with noise.
The city became loud with celebration.
This is the noise you hear now.
passages.original: וַיִּמְשְׁח֣וּ אֹת֡וֹ צָד֣וֹק הַכֹּהֵ֣ן וְנָתָן֩ הַנָּבִ֨יא לְמֶ֜לֶךְ בְּגִח֗וֹן וַיַּעֲל֤וּ מִשָּׁם֙ שְׂמֵחִ֔ים וַתֵּהֹ֖ם הַקִּרְיָ֑ה ה֥וּא הַקּ֖וֹל אֲשֶׁ֥ר שְׁמַעְתֶּֽם׃

passages.text: Moreover, Solomon has taken his seat on the royal throne.
passages.sermon: Solomon is the son of King David.\r\nSolomon has become king.\r\nSolomon has sat on the royal throne.
passages.original: וְגַם֙ יָשַׁ֣ב שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה עַ֖ל כִּסֵּ֥א הַמְּלוּכָֽה׃

passages.text: The king’s servants have also gone to congratulate our lord King David, saying, ‘May your God make the name of Solomon more famous than your own name, and may He make his throne greater than your throne.’ And the king has bowed in worship on his bed, saying, ‘Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel! Today He has provided one to sit on my throne, and my eyes have seen it.’ ”
passages.sermon:
King David was old and near death.
King David’s servants went to him.
They congratulated King David.
They said, “May your God make Solomon’s name greater than your name.
May God make Solomon’s throne greater than your throne.”
King David was lying on his bed.
King David bowed in worship on his bed.
King David said, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel.
Today the LORD has given me a son to sit on my throne.
My eyes have seen it.”
passages.original: וְגַם־ בָּ֜אוּ עַבְדֵ֣י הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ לְ֠בָרֵךְ אֶת־ אֲדֹנֵ֜ינוּ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִד֮ לֵאמֹר֒ יֵיטֵ֨ב אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶת־ שֵׁ֤ם שְׁלֹמֹה֙ מִשְּׁמֶ֔ךָ וִֽיגַדֵּ֥ל אֶת־ כִּסְא֖וֹ מִכִּסְאֶ֑ךָ וַיִּשְׁתַּ֥חוּ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ עַל־ הַמִּשְׁכָּֽב׃ וְגַם־ כָּ֖כָה אָמַ֣ר הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ בָּר֨וּךְ יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֥ן הַיּ֛וֹם יֹשֵׁ֥ב עַל־ כִּסְאִ֖י וְעֵינַ֥י רֹאֽוֹת׃

passages.text: At this, all the guests of Adonijah arose in terror and scattered.
passages.sermon:
Adonijah held a feast.
He invited many guests.
News came that Solomon became king.
All the guests heard this news.
The guests became afraid.
They stood up quickly.
Each guest left the place.
Each person went his own way.
passages.original: וַיֶּֽחֶרְדוּ֙ וַיָּקֻ֔מוּ כָּל־ הַ֨קְּרֻאִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר לַאֲדֹנִיָּ֑הוּ וַיֵּלְכ֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ לְדַרְכּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: But Adonijah, in fear of Solomon, got up and went to take hold of the horns of the altar.
passages.sermon:
Adonijah feared Solomon.
Adonijah got up.
Adonijah went to the altar.
Adonijah took hold of the horns of the altar.
passages.original: וַאֲדֹ֣נִיָּ֔הוּ יָרֵ֖א מִפְּנֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה וַיָּ֣קָם וַיֵּ֔לֶךְ וַֽיַּחֲזֵ֖ק בְּקַרְנ֥וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃

passages.text: It was reported to Solomon: “Behold, Adonijah fears King Solomon, and he has taken hold of the horns of the altar, saying, ‘Let King Solomon first swear to me not to put his servant to the sword.’ ”
passages.sermon:
Adonijah was afraid of King Solomon.
Adonijah went to the altar.
Adonijah grabbed the horns of the altar.
Someone told Solomon about this.
They said, “Adonijah is afraid of King Solomon.
He is holding the horns of the altar.
He says, ‘Let King Solomon swear to me today.
He must promise not to kill his servant with the sword.’”
passages.original: וַיֻּגַּ֤ד לִשְׁלֹמֹה֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הִנֵּה֙ אֲדֹ֣נִיָּ֔הוּ יָרֵ֖א אֶת־ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה וְ֠הִנֵּה אָחַ֞ז בְּקַרְנ֤וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר יִשָּֽׁבַֽע־ לִ֤י כַיּוֹם֙ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה אִם־ יָמִ֥ית אֶת־ עַבְדּ֖וֹ בֶּחָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: And Solomon replied, “If he is a man of character, not a single hair of his will fall to the ground. But if evil is found in him, he will die.”
passages.sermon:
Solomon was the new king of Israel.
Solomon spoke about Adonijah.
Solomon said, "If Adonijah is a man of good character, nothing bad will happen to him."
Not even a single hair from his head will fall to the ground.
But if Adonijah does evil, he will die."
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה אִ֚ם יִהְיֶ֣ה לְבֶן־ חַ֔יִל לֹֽא־ יִפֹּ֥ל מִשַּׂעֲרָת֖וֹ אָ֑רְצָה וְאִם־ רָעָ֥ה תִמָּצֵא־ ב֖וֹ וָמֵֽת׃

passages.text: So King Solomon summoned Adonijah down from the altar, and he came and bowed down before King Solomon, who said to him, “Go to your home.”
passages.sermon:
King Solomon ruled Israel.
Adonijah feared King Solomon.
Adonijah held the horns of the altar for safety.
King Solomon sent for Adonijah.
They brought Adonijah down from the altar.
Adonijah came to King Solomon.
Adonijah bowed down before King Solomon.
King Solomon spoke to Adonijah.
King Solomon said, "Go to your home."
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֞ח הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה וַיֹּרִדֻ֙הוּ֙ מֵעַ֣ל הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וַיָּבֹ֕א וַיִּשְׁתַּ֖חוּ לַמֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה וַיֹּֽאמֶר־ ל֥וֹ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לֵ֥ךְ לְבֵיתֶֽךָ׃פ
